# BizXtreme Three.js Client

Chimera II OS now recognizes the Three.js BizXtreme client as a browser/Web UI companion target.

The client is intentionally aligned with the Unity edition through shared data contracts for story chapters, live events, starter items, inventory and marketplace content. The original game concept remains the primary experience.

Three.js provides the 3D browser layer. WebGL is the baseline compatibility path, while WebGPU can be selected when capability detection and the target browser permit it. Wallet operations remain isolated behind provider/chain adapters and never place private keys or seed phrases in game telemetry or server APIs.
